title: Jesus... Why Am I Still Not Enough?

bible.text: So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him. The son said to him, "Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son." But the father said to his servants, "Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet. Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let's have a feast and celebrate. For this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found."

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why do I always feel like I'm not enough? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Not good enough for my family. Not successful enough. Not strong enough. I keep comparing myself to everyone.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You keep measuring your worth by what you think you have failed to become.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Because when I look at my life, all I can see are the things I got wrong.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The son who came home thought he was no longer worthy to be called a son.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But his father still ran toward him...

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Yes. He came home carrying shame, but his father met him with compassion.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So I don't have to become perfect before I come back to God?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: No. You come as you are. Your failures don't make you worthless. You are still someone I call back home. 🤍

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You may see everything you've lost. God sees the person who has come home. Don't let shame convince you to stay far away.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Have you ever felt like you weren't enough? 🙏 Remember this today: your failures are not your identity.
